prose: Austin Walters is a Biomagnetism researcher, teacher, and practitioner, a technique that uses magnets to balance the biofield, similar to using sound. We learn about stepping stones in his journey to his modality, like colloidal silver, pulsed electromagnetic field devices, pH and leg length discrepancy, and his ability to use his own body as a surrogate for clients during remote sessions.
ext: We talk about knowledge of cancer, based on his care for his late wife, internal fungal decomposition, caring for the biological terrain, muscle testing to talk to the body, the power of the name, sleeping with magnets, and much more.
